title: Sync
summary: Instances of the app sync their databases over the local network.
description: The author uses the app on more than one machine and wants the same book on each, without a cloud service in between.

stories.as: an author who writes on more than one machine
stories.want: the same book on each of them
stories.soThat: I can pick up wherever I left off

requirements.text: Two instances of the app on the same local network can sync their databases with each other.
